facts.fact: 没人见过 Star 或她男友（码头、廉价旅馆都找过）；新泽西家人已数周无音讯；去第九分局，警察只是大笑。
facts.anchor: But no one had seen Star, or the boyfriend. We asked around at the piers, we went by the fleabag hotel where she sometimes took a john. We called up her family in New Jersey—they hadn’t disowned her but they didn’t really tolerate her either, and occasionally they were in touch—and they hadn’t heard from her in weeks. As a last resort, we went to the Ninth Precinct, and they just laughed and laughed.

facts.fact: 夜里她设灵守——Bianca 与女友们来念玫瑰经；她希望的不是信教，而是有一门共同的祈祷语言，能认真对待别人的痛苦并代其承接。
facts.anchor: Bianca and her girls came over to pray the rosary so Star could go to heaven if she wasn’t coming home. Her beautiful friends worked the beads with their fingers, and I wished not to be religious per se, but to have some sort of shared language of prayer, some way to take someone else’s pain seriously and to know how to hold it for them.

facts.fact: 她看烛火摇动：那么热、亮、活着，却又那么容易被一支支吹灭。
facts.anchor: I watched the candles flicker, so hot and bright and alive but so easy to blow out one at a time.

facts.fact: 最后一招是打电话给医院（不能指望警察）；她知道该问什么——多年前她曾找过生病的母亲；只能由她来。
facts.anchor: The last resort was to call the hospitals. We couldn’t rely on the police to do it for us, and I knew what to say, because one time, years ago, I had to find my mother when she was sick. So it had to be me.

facts.fact: 她拨了 Claude 给的护士站号码（纸条还贴在冰箱上）；是 Claude 本人接的：「别挂」——「我不会挂你电话。怎么了，你听起来——」
facts.anchor: “I wouldn’t hang up on you. What’s going on, you sound—”

facts.fact: Claude 问：Star 是她的正式名字吗？
她多希望 Claude 见过她、多希望与 Claude 已相恋多年、见过她爱的所有人；她开始描述 Star——连生日是情人节都说了，随即意识到这未必属实。
facts.anchor: I wished Claude had met her. I wished Claude and I had dated for years and years and she knew everyone I loved.

facts.fact: Claude 说：七楼有个符合描述的人；情况稳定，但被打得很重、无法辨认，还不能说话。
facts.anchor: Renata, listen to me. We have someone who fits your friend’s description on seven. She’s stable, but she’s—she’s been badly beaten, and we can’t identify her. She hasn’t been able to talk to us yet.”

facts.fact: 她开始听见静电声，像在耳朵后面、在身体里面；她只问：为何不在急诊？——因为已被转到七楼。
facts.anchor: I started hearing static, like it was behind my ears, inside me.

facts.fact: 她声音劈了：那个狗杂种一定把她打到快死就丢下了；想到刷白的公寓，不知他把她扔在哪、是否以为她会被人找到。
facts.anchor: That piece of shit bastard, he must have left her for dead.”

facts.fact: Bianca 问在急诊吗；她答：不，她在七楼。
Leon 的抵抗：又是「我们」——你说的这个「我们」包含谁？（随后仍挽起她的手臂往西走。）
facts.anchor: Who is included in this we of whom you speak?”

facts.fact: 她对 Leon：无论医院多糟，我们都负担不起对它的心理情结；你既然在这儿，就跟我去。
facts.anchor: We can’t afford to get a complex about going to the hospital, no matter how awful it is. You’re here, come with me.”
